title: Master Thesis
tagline: Your contribution to the field, begun.
welcome: The thesis is where you stop only consuming knowledge and begin contributing it. This course guides you from proposal to defense.
vignette: A candidate stands before her committee. The question she chose began with one child she could not forget. The thesis is that child's story, made general and rigorous. Scholarship, at its best, is love made systematic.
vignette_attr: A thesis defense, drawn from experience
description: A guided thesis sequence: selecting and refining a research question, the literature review, research ethics and proposal defense, methodology aligned to the question, academic writing and citation, interpreting findings, and preparing the defense. Independent research and supervisor meetings remain separate requirements.
questions: What question is mine to answer?
What does the literature already say, and where is the gap?
How do I write and defend with clarity and humility?
importance: The thesis certifies you as a producer of knowledge
It deepens your expertise in a chosen area
It prepares you for doctoral study and scholarly practice
misconceptions: that the thesis must be groundbreaking, when it must be sound
that it is a solitary ordeal, when it is supervised collaboration
figures: who guide and examine your work
The scholars of your chosen topic
whose trust makes the work possible
outcomes: You will settle a focused, significant question.
You will map the field and the gap.
You will defend a sound, ethical proposal.
You will choose and justify your methodology.
You will write clearly with correct citation.
You will discuss results with humility and prepare the defense.
modules: The right question makes the work possible.
The proposal is your contract with rigor.
Method serves question, never the reverse.
The defense is a conversation among colleagues.
assessment: Assessment is the thesis milestone sequence.
tips: Meet your supervisor prepared every time
Write a little every week; momentum is everything
Treat the mock defense as the real one
integration: The thesis integrates every skill of the degree into one original contribution.
faith: We offer our scholarship as service, humble before truth and before the young it serves.
closing: May your thesis be a lamp you carry onward, and may it serve the children you will meet.
